blocks.text: Spent the day touring vineyards just outside Bordeaux - rows and rows of vines stretching to the horizon, and a cellar tour where I finally learned the difference between the Left Bank and Right Bank blends.

Back in the city that evening, the Garonne river was lit up gold, and the old warehouses along the Quai des Chartrons have all been turned into wine bars - a perfect place to actually taste what I'd learned about.
